notes: Lead: BillFlux Systems (billing workflow for mid-market SaaS). Initial ask: replace rule-based support macros with an LLM-driven support agent that can (1) surface subscription state, (2) propose refunds/credits, and (3) call payment ops (Stripe/Zuora) via safe tool calls. POC scope: chat agent for billing/support reps, structured JSON responses for downstream automation (refund_request, credit_amount, invoice_link). Important constraints: < 400ms p50 response for streaming chat UI, deterministic JSON schema for actions, strict audit logs for tool calls, SSO + SOC2 compliance. AE notes: customer is eager to use hosted API to validate latency and structured outputs quickly; if POC meets SLOs and security questions cleared they will move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation. Quoted: "We need JSON outputs we can wire into our refunds pipeline — schema must be enforced." Technical: currently using Stripe for payments and Zuora for subscription lifecycle; they want Redwood to run tool calls to create credits/refunds for subscription items and to fetch invoice history. Concern: cost sensitivity on token usage — asking about Optimize recommendations (batching/caching, quantization) and per-token breakdown. POC success criteria: 1) streaming p50 < 400ms on typical 200-token exchanges, 2) 95% of structured action outputs validate against JSON schema, 3) end-to-end tool-call execution mapped in audit logs and replayable.
